review_candidates.title: Strategic Finance Manager
review_candidates.description: Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation. We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel. As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business. This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale. Your Mission As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations. Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved. Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance. You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership. For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow. What You Will Own Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence. Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them. Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule. Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly. Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company. Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines. Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance. Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required. Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance. Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units. Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models. Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs. Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage. Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins. Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level. Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets. Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team. What We Are Looking For A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers. Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy. A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles. The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data. Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Strong capabilities in financial reconciliation, controls and problem-solving. A commercial mindset—you do more than report figures; you understand their meaning and implications for the wider business. A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability. The confidence to work independently, find solutions and navigate unfamiliar challenges. The ability to perform in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve quickly. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. The confidence to communicate and work directly with senior management. A genuine interest in technology, automation and AI, together with the ability to identify opportunities to improve and automate finance processes. The ambition to grow quickly and assume substantially greater responsibility over time. Experience in accounting, audit, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, consulting, hospitality, real estate or a high-growth startup would be highly valuable. A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics or another analytical discipline is preferred, although exceptional applicants from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply. What Success Will Look Like During Your First 6–12 Months, You Will Have Developed a detailed understanding of the financial performance of every major area of The Flex. Established dependable monthly management reporting across the company. Ensured that payments from booking platforms and commercial partners are fully reconciled and that all expected funds are received. Significantly improved visibility into cash flow, profitability and unit economics. Uncovered meaningful opportunities to lower costs and improve margins. Automated several finance processes that were previously completed manually. Established yourself as a trusted financial partner to the founders and management team. Taken responsibility for increasingly important areas of the company’s finance function. Why Join The Flex? Become part of a rapidly growing international business operating at the intersection of real estate, hospitality and technology. Work closely and directly with the company’s founders and senior leaders. Gain hands-on exposure to the financial operations of a business spanning multiple countries. Influence profitability and contribute directly to major strategic and commercial decisions. Help design and build the finance function instead of simply taking over an established set of processes. Apply technology and AI to reimagine how a modern finance function should operate. Take meaningful ownership and responsibility from your first day. Receive a competitive salary together with performance-based incentives. Benefit from exceptional long-term career progression as The Flex continues its international expansion. You Should Not Apply If You want a conventional corporate 9-to-5 position with limited and narrowly defined responsibilities. You rely on someone else to continuously tell you what needs to be done. You are uncomfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for the quality of your work. You would rather report financial figures than understand, challenge and improve them. You engage in workplace politics, gossip or conversations about colleagues behind their backs. You are searching for a slow-moving, predictable role with limited career progression. You do not aspire to become one of the very best in the world at what you do.

Staff Engineer – Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST) Role Overview As a Staff Engineer on the Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST) team , you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the core distributed storage, replication, and transaction foundations of YugabyteDB. You will work on some of the most challenging problems in distributed systems — including consistency, durability, fault tolerance, performance, and scalability — while collaborating closely with query layer, platform, and cloud teams. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in low-level systems work and want to shape the future of a globally distributed database. Key Responsibilities Lead the design, development, testing, and delivery of core storage and replication features in YugabyteDB. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, distributed team environment Preferred Skills Hands-on experience with distributed storage systems, transactional engines, or consensus protocols. Familiarity with LSM-tree based storage engines, WALs, snapshots, or compaction strategies. Experience with PostgreSQL internals or other relational database engines is a strong plus. Architectural maturity – You understand boundaries, contracts, invariants, and how local decisions impact system coherence over time. Value-driven mindset – You care about solving the right problem sustainably, not just shipping features. Building well-structured, testable backend services and clean, reusable frontend components — with attention to performance, usability, and long-term maintainability. Modelling domains, defining boundaries, and contributing to architectural decisions that keep the system coherent as it scales. Using AI tools to accelerate development — while reviewing, validating, and refining generated code before it reaches production. Owning work beyond feature delivery: CI/CD, observability, performance, and production behaviour. review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Mission System Architect – C2 (Command & Control) & Infrastructure Location: Portsmouth (Broad Oak) or Frimley, Filton, Dorchester, hybrid – 3 days on site – this role will require routine travel to other southern BAE sites within UK and occasionally internationally. Salary: Up to £89, 520 dependent on experience Who We Are Join BAE Systems and you’ll be part of something bigger. As a valued member of our global colleague network, you’ll bring your unique skills and perspectives to help pioneer progress and protect what matters most. You’ll be trusted to play your part in delivering the advanced, technology-led defence, aerospace and security solutions of tomorrow, shaping a safer future, for all of us. From the depths of the ocean, to the far reaches of space, there’s no limit to where a career at BAE Systems could take you. What You’ll Be Doing As a Senior Mission System Architect (C2 & Infrastructure), you will provide technical leadership in the architecture, design, integration and assurance of mission-critical command and control systems and hosting infrastructure for future maritime platforms. You will define architectural strategies that enable Hybrid Navy capabilities, ensuring solutions are modular, secure, resilient, interoperable and scalable across multiple domains and coalition environments. Working closely with customers, programmes, suppliers and industry partners, you will influence strategic direction, champion modern digital technologies and open architectures, and deliver robust disaggregated mission system solutions that support operational effectiveness, future growth and export opportunities. Core Duties Lead end-to-end C2 and infrastructure architecture strategy and governance. Define scalable, secure, hosting environments supporting mission-critical operations. Champion open architectures, interoperability standards and digital engineering approaches. Embed cyber resilience, assurance and compliance throughout architectural designs. Influence customers, partners and programmes to align architectural direction. Ensure high-performance, reliable and future-ready command and control solutions. Essential Skills A degree in Engineering (or a related subject) – Full membership of an appropriate engineering institution and be a Chartered Engineer. Extensive experience in force-level system-of-systems architectural design and maritime defence integration. Strong expertise in C2 systems, distributed infrastructure, cyber security and digital engineering. Combat System Engineering Team Within the dynamic and rapidly expanding Naval Ships Combat Systems business, you will form part of a highly skilled team of system architects charged with shaping the future of maritime mission systems. Working across domestic and international programmes alongside enterprise partners, in bringing to bear your specialist expertise, you will ensure that candidate solutions are innovative, future-force-ready, operationally relevant and coherent with customer and business needs. . Why BAE Systems? Here you’ll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. With lifelong learning and meaningful work, this is a place where you can grow your career with confidence and be empowered to be your best. You’ll be recognised for your contribution and enjoy rewards tailored to what’s most important to you and your family, support for your financial and personal wellbeing, as well as a balanced lifestyle. In an environment embracing sustainable ways of working and with a strong sense of shared purpose, our supportive culture is a place you can feel you belong and proud of the difference you make. A Place Where Everyone Can Thrive We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We know that a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences strengthens our teams and is vital to the work we do. Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks. Closing Date: 22nd September 2026, interviews for this role will take place w/c 12th October We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible. #combatsystems

review_candidates.title: Senior Contracts Manager
review_candidates.description: Summary: The role provides senior contractual support to the EPC leadership team and works closely with Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Project Controls, Finance, Legal, and site teams to ensure contracts are administered in accordance with agreed terms, project requirements, and the JV's governance framework. Key Responsibilities: Lead the administration of EPC contracts, major subcontracts, purchase agreements, and other project-related contractual arrangements. Ensure contractual obligations, deliverables, milestones, notices, securities, warranties, insurance requirements, and other key provisions are properly monitored and complied with. Support the development, negotiation, award, and administration of major construction and specialist subcontracts. Lead the contractual assessment and management of variations, change orders, claims, extensions of time, and other contractual entitlements. Identify contractual and commercial risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle. Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Commercial Management, Law, or a related discipline. • Minimum 13 years of relevant experience, with substantial experience in contracts and commercial management on major EPC or construction projects. • Strong experience in the power, energy, infrastructure, industrial, or major construction sectors. • Demonstrated experience administering high-value EPC contracts and major subcontracts. • Strong practical experience in claims, variations, extensions of time, contractual notices, change management, and dispute avoidance. • Experience working on large, complex, multi-contractor and multinational projects is highly desirable.

review_candidates.title: Sales Representative
review_candidates.company: CES - MATLAB® in the Middle East
review_candidates.description: Role Overview As a Sales Representative, you will drive revenue growth by positioning and selling the engineering and scientific software portfolio from MathWorks along with associated services such as consulting and product training. The role focuses on managing and developing a defined territory, strengthening strategic relationships with leading organisations, identifying new opportunities within existing customers, and converting new prospects into long term accounts. You will lead the full sales cycle and collaborate closely with technical and marketing teams to deliver measurable business outcomes for customers. Responsibilities Manage the complete sales cycle including opportunity creation, qualification, technical evaluation coordination, proof of concept support, value positioning, and successful deal closure. Achieve quarterly and annual revenue objectives through a consultative, value-based sales approach aligned with customer engineering and innovation priorities. Develop and execute territory and account plans that focus on strengthening strategic relationships and increasing long term customer engagement. Identify additional initiatives, projects, and departments within existing customers to broaden adoption of solutions and increase account value over time. Work with stakeholders across technical teams, engineering leadership, and executive management to understand business challenges and align solutions to organisational objectives. Strengthen senior level relationships within key accounts to support wider adoption of platforms and services. Build new business pipelines by proactively identifying and engaging potential customers across the assigned territory. Partner closely with Application Engineering, Marketing, and broader Sales teams to shape account strategies and coordinated outreach activities. Maintain accurate pipeline visibility, opportunity tracking, and forecasting using the CRM system. Contribute market insights and customer feedback to help refine regional growth strategies and campaign focus. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree. 3 to 5 years of direct sales experience working with customers in the MENA region, ideally selling technology, engineering software, or technical solutions. Demonstrated ability to develop relationships, identify new opportunities within existing customers, and grow strategic accounts. Experience working with CRM systems to manage opportunities and sales activities. Fluency in Arabic and English. Valid KSA Driver’s License.
